Public settlement shouldn’t mean public finances.

03 / SELECTIVE DISCLOSURE

Tell them exactly enough.

Auditors, counterparties, lenders, and teams rarely need your entire financial history. Scrim produces a short-lived proof for one reader and one purpose.

  • 01A payment was made
  • 02A balance exceeds a threshold
  • 03A payroll batch matches a total
  • 04An agent stayed inside its limit

04 / AGENT RAILS

Give agents a budget.
Never a blank check.

Every agent action is evaluated before settlement. Limits are hard, counterparties are explicit, and proof permissions are constrained by policy.

Allowlisted payeesNamed counterparties only
Approval gatesHuman review over a threshold

One private state.
Many settlement paths.

Scrim is designed around NEAR’s chain abstraction stack, with each layer doing one job and exposing the minimum necessary information.

07 / TRUST MODEL

Privacy starts with
who never gets the key.

01

User-held keys

Device-side or approved TEE-assisted proving keeps custody with the owner.

02

Hard expiry

Every disclosure proof stops verifying after its stated time.

03

Bound readers

A proof names its intended reader. Changing the reader invalidates it.

04

Minimal footprint

Public settlement records reveal only what execution requires.
